module_role: Hardware host-device interface between a NAND Flash controller (master) and one or more NAND Targets (slaves) within a NAND package, defining wires + cycle types + command set + status / parameter / unique-ID readback + features.

integration_overview.wire_count_sdr_x8_basic: 12-14 (CE_n, CLE, ALE, WE_n, RE_n, WP_n, R/B_n, DQ[7:0], Vcc/VccQ/Vss/VssQ)
integration_overview.wire_count_nv_ddr_x8_basic: 13-15 (adds DQS; WE_n/CLK and RE_n/W/R_n shared pins)
integration_overview.wire_directions: CE_n/CLE/ALE/WE_n/WP_n: host→device. RE_n/CLK: host→device. R/B_n: device→host (open-drain). DQ: bidirectional. DQS: bidirectional (NV-DDR family). Vcc/VccQ/Vss/VssQ: power.
integration_overview.chip_select_per_target: Each target is selected by its CE_n; pin reduction shares CE_n with Volume Address.
integration_overview.controller_role: Host generates all strobes and initiates every transaction.
integration_overview.open_drain_rbn: R/B_n open-drain; multi-target wire-OR; external pull-up required.

interface_categories: Power (Vcc, VccQ, Vss, VssQ; optional Vpp; EZ NAND VDDi)
Control (CE_n, CLE, ALE, WE_n/CLK, RE_n/RE_t/RE_c/W/R_n, WP_n)
interconnect_topologies_supported: Single-controller + multiple-target with CE_n pin reduction (Volume Select).
default_signal_values_when_omitted: External pull-up on R/B_n (typ. 1-10 kΩ); WP_n per board policy; ZQ tied to Vss via RZQ (300 Ω ±1 %); ENi pulled to defined level for enumeration; VSP internal pull-up/down per vendor spec.
soc_dependent_items: ONFI-compliant NAND Flash Controller (NFC) IP with channel scheduler + ECC engine.
Per-channel PHY (SDR LVCMOS or NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 source-sync DDR).
Per-channel VccQ regulator (3.3 V / 1.8 V / 1.2 V).
External RZQ resistor (typ. 300 Ω ±1 %) on each ZQ pin to Vss.
Interrupt routing (per-LUN ready, ECC error, ECC threshold).

low_power_modes.Standby: CE_n HIGH while target ready; ICC1 typical.
low_power_modes.Deep_power_down: Vendor-defined via Set Features or Vcc/VccQ removal.
low_power_modes.ClockStop_NV_DDR: Host may stop CLK during NV-DDR Idle.
low_power_modes.Sleep: Not explicitly named; CE_n + CLK gated.

compatibility_notes: All ONFI devices power-up into SDR data interface, timing mode 0. Host shall Reset (FFh) before any commands.
Switching to NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 via Set Features (01h). Reset (FFh) drops to SDR; Synchronous Reset (FCh) preserves.
ECC scheme on raw NAND is host responsibility; EZ NAND offloads ECC.
Multi-vendor mixing on a channel discouraged due to ICC / VccQ / drive-strength matching.
ONFI 4.x is backward compatible at the SDR command level with all prior revisions.
